prompt: A vertical amateur snapshot on cheap 35mm colour negative film, pushed at night, heavy grain, slightly soft focus, underexposed, a cold teal-green fluorescent cast. Close-up of a bread shelf in a small British corner shop: one plain white sliced loaf left on a bare metal shelf, its paper shelf-edge price label reading exactly "£50" in black marker, older crossed-out prices beneath it. The fluorescent tube above is half dead, so the left of the frame falls into murky darkness. Crumbs, a torn plastic bag clip, dust. Flash not used, available light only, nobody in the shop. Thanks.
